title: timing / session.ended (v1) data payload
description: The ACTUAL (physical) end of a session plus its summary, emitted by Timing. Published to the 'timing.events' exchange with routing key 'session.ended'. Consumers: Booking, Billing (close tab), Driver (store summary), Mailing (session summary), Leaderboard (mark finished). NOTE: the per-item shape of `summary[]` is NOT pinned by the source corpus and is intentionally left tolerant (additionalProperties:true, no required item fields) — no Epic-1 consumer reads summary contents. Pin the item fields when Driver/Mailing actually consume them (Epic 3/10). Confirm-at-build, do not invent.

sessionId.description: The session that ended. Same id space as lap.recorded.sessionId.

endedAt.description: When the session actually ended. RFC3339 UTC, exactly 3-digit milliseconds, literal 'Z' (AR9). The pattern is enforced (format is annotation-only).

summary.description: Per-session result rows (e.g. one per driver, with lap times). Item shape intentionally unpinned for v1 — tolerant object.
